limitations: Chromium automation does not establish physical mouse/touchpad smoothness or real-device performance.
Reserved classic scrollbars are exercised with a local browser-only 15px scrollbar stylesheet.
Footer wave paths are compared by their owning SVG viewport: the unchanged RAF wave shape has a different phase between pages.
Baseline regression snapshots synchronize CSS animation time only: finite entrances finish and infinite floats pause at 1000ms. Actual Works scroll tests do not alter animations.

Without JavaScript, compact intrinsic Hero height cannot be measured into the Works variable; these extra compact fallback cases require readable ordinary flow rather than an exact intrinsic height match.
